_doc: Local delegation lane -- SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which local model serves delegated legs. This is the ONLY operational file that names a model; docs point here and never restate it. No ambient env var selects the model (X12 lesson: a persistent CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL once silently outranked every model pin for weeks). Resolution order is exactly: --model flag (explicit, per-invocation, visible in transcript) > this file. Swap with: python tools/delegate.py --use <tag>. Doctrine: docs/osanwe-runtime-reference.md 'Local model lane'.
_lane_note: 'glimmer' names the LANE, not the model. The operator's phrase ('use glimmer for what it can handle') survives every model swap verbatim.

_ctx_note: Context length the launcher PINS when it starts the Ollama daemon (tools/lane-arm.ps1). Daemon context is frozen at daemon START, and three different values coexist on this machine (GUI 262144, HKLM 65536, the retired PS-profile qwen map 131072). Pinning here stops the daemon's context from depending on which shell happened to launch it. Re-derived 2026-08-14 for qwen3.8:27b: /api/show reports qwen35.context_length = 262144, so the pin moved 131072 -> 262144 and OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL moved to 1 in BOTH tools/lane-arm.ps1 and tools/claude-launcher.ps1. CORRECTED 2026-08-18: the earlier note claimed '2 x 262144 holds the same total as the old 4 x 131072', which is false -- ctx doubled, so the KV budget doubled with it. lane-arm.ps1:83 had already been corrected to 1 on 2026-08-15 (ollama derates 2 to -np 1 in practice); claude-launcher.ps1 still said 2 until now. MEASURED at 1 slot: 30,094 MiB of 32,607 used, 2,513 free -- there is no headroom for a second slot, and above it the load fails with 'failed to allocate buffer for rs cache', the recurrent-state cache for the 48 Gated DeltaNet layers being a third consumer beside weights and KV. Mirrored into config/mode-local.settings.json (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS = this value, CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW = 209715 ~= 80%); those two key names are load-bearing because checkall's ctx lint SKIPS absent keys.

relay._doc: Relay-worker protocol constants (tools/relay.py; GATE-B gate-b-relay-worker-2026-08-16). INVARIANT (checkall-linted once the lint ships): relay_threshold_tokens + relay_reserve_tokens + max_result_tokens <= w_eff_tokens, with max_result_tokens = min(32768, 0.15 * w_eff_tokens). W_eff = 262144 per experiment R0 2026-08-16 (prefix reuse WORKS on /api/chat; discriminator is prompt_eval_duration, not count). If a future engine change breaks reuse, drop w_eff_tokens to the prefill-economic window and every other number scales; the protocol is unchanged.

roles._doc: Role library (GATE-B gate-b-local-orchestration-program-2026-08-17). Keyed by LEG-FAMILY PREFIX (leg.split(':')[0]); relay.py resolves the role from the leg id (--role overrides explicitly, X12: no ambient selection). tools[] is BOTH the TOOL_DEFS subset advertised to the model AND the executor allowlist (out-of-role calls are REFUSED AND LOGGED). raw_reads: payloads escape non-ASCII as \uXXXX (reversible) instead of Pattern-22 normalizing -- required for byte-exact propose_edit olds. expose_sha: source wrapper header carries the file SHA256 for before_sha256. An unmapped prefix with no --role is REFUSED (fail closed). Role identity (file sha + tools) is FROZEN into run state at leg creation; --resume refuses on role-file drift. NOTE: interleaving legs of different roles evicts each other's KV prefix cache on the single Ollama slot -- relay-batch stable-sorts by family for this reason.

_default_note: off = delegation happens only when the operator asks (any wording pairing the lane with a scope hint) or launcher mode-2 selection-is-consent. Promotion to on, pre-registered (BOTH must hold): (1) 20+ qualifying legs with zero verification failures in the receipts ledger -- MISMATCH fabrication-grade counts as a failure, MISMATCH drift-possible does NOT; (2) the parity rule at wiki/research/parity-eval-rule-2026-08-17.md passes (median >= 97, no task < 90, every session share <= 5). The flip itself is /decide-ratified and consists of exactly this field plus the AGENTS.md scope clause; demotion is AUTOMATIC per the rule doc (fabrication-grade event or 2 consecutive nightly consistency divergences).

compose._note: Relay leg family reserved 2026-08-17. NO composer role ships: the measurement said a compose leg is net-NEGATIVE (max win ~16K output against >=9 added orchestrator turns), and the anti-fabrication property it would have relied on is false -- value_occurs is unit- and field-blind, so a fabricated '60%' conviction grounds cleanly against an unrelated 'price 60.00'. This block exists ONLY to make leg_status() fail CLOSED: an UNMAPPED prefix returns 'ok' (delegate.py:392-393), so without it every compose:* id is permitted by name. never_local here is a mission-scope mirror, NOT enforcement -- it stops a leg NAMED compose:rating and does nothing about a leg named compose:table whose mission asks for a rating.
